Phase 45 implementation — cockpit lanes. Branch phase-45-cockpit-lanes @ a919792 (PR to follow). gate: see entry @ a919792.

What changed, where:
- tagteam/data/web/cockpit.html — the Cycle region + Lead tab are replaced by two lanes under Needs you: #lane-lead (header: #lane-lead-name "<lead> — lead", #lane-lead-state, conversation #lead-select + New; #lead-timeline; #lead-empty; #lead-status; the composer #lead-form with Stop turn / Send) | #lane-token | #lane-reviewer (header: #lane-reviewer-name, #lane-reviewer-state; #reviewer-timeline; #reviewer-empty). Tabs: Rounds · Diff · Usage · Notes; the Rounds panel gains <details id="all-activity"> holding #activity, #activity-empty, #activity-more, #activity-meta (in the summary). Removed: #tab-lead, #tab-lead-name, #lead-dot, #panel-lead, #lead-title, #lead-continuity, #lead-transcript, #cycle, #cycle-line, #activity-head.
- tagteam/data/web/cockpit.js — renderLanes(n) (headers, plain-word states, pulse, token) replaces renderCycle; one keyed row store makeStore(name, containerId, ascending) in three instances: ACT (flat list, running first/newest first), RLANE (reviewer lane, ascending: role reviewer|gatekeeper × kind cycle|gate|panel|panel_lens), LLANE (lead lane cards: role lead × kind cycle); upsertRow keys/patches/re-inserts on sort-key change via insertKeyed (sticks a timeline to its foot when the reader was at the foot); one /api/activity fetch feeds all three; streams shared via the registry with <store>:<id> handler names; upsertActivity/insertActRow kept as wrappers. Verdicts: loadFeed fills ROUNDS_BY_N from /api/rounds entries (reviewer action+text, gate action) and calls refreshVerdicts; verdictFor maps VERDICT_WORD {APPROVE, REQUEST_CHANGES, ESCALATE, NEED_HUMAN, GATE_PASS, GATE_BOUNCE} (gates from raw_status); "what it said" toggles the round text under the card. Lead lane: messages are keyed rows msg:<cid>:<n> (you + lead bubbles; refilled only when the signature changes; kept lines under a disclosure), merged in time with LLANE cards; renderLeadTimeline replaces renderConversation (no container wipe); switching conversation removes the other's rows. refreshAll runs loadFeed, loadActivity, loadLead(false) every pass (no tab condition; activeTab()==='lead' gone). renderLeadGate names where the work streams ("streaming above · watch it" / "streaming in the reviewer lane · watch it" → focusWorkingLane). Inside a lane cards show time only (tooltip = full date) and hide role/agent columns; renderLaneAges ticks ages across stores + the working banner. Removed every write to the removed ids.
- tagteam/data/web/cockpit.css — .lanes grid 1fr 44px 1fr (stack < 1000px, lead first), .lane flex column with header / timeline (46vh, newest at foot) / composer at the foot; .verdict tags; .act-text; .all-activity; lane cards compact.
- docs — HTW #cockpit "Lanes" bullet + #lead; README lanes paragraph + alt text; media manifest; cockpit-issues note; plan doc "Implementation notes".
- docs/media/screenshots — cockpit-cycle / cockpit-lead / cockpit-needs-you / cockpit-usage recaptured (1280×800, no text chunks).
- tests/test_cockpit_activity.py — guards updated (ids present incl. the four inside #all-activity; removed ids absent from HTML and no $('<id>') in the JS; loadLead(false) in refreshAll and no activeTab()==='lead'; store.rows keyed; no innerHTML on activity/lead-timeline/reviewer-timeline; VERDICT_WORD exactly six; inReviewerLane/inLeadLane; Phase 37 XSS guard kept; LEAD.msgRows/upsertLeadMessage); node harness now evaluates the lanes block + the chat block; TestLanesBehaviour (2): reviewer lane ascending with the pre-check before its review, running review streams then is patched in place with the verdict word and its text, role-split counts (5/3/2); lead lane merges messages + cards in time order, patches without wiping (same node, details kept), conversation switch keeps cards. Existing Phase 43 harness test still passes on the wrappers.

Verified: focused runs green while working (251 across cockpit/launchpad/server/gatekeeper/hub/docs); manual Playwright walk on the seed (running review on demo-web: reviewer lane pulses and streams while the lead lane holds the chat + composer; idle demo-idle: chat in the lead lane, reviewer lane empty state; escalated demo-api: verdict words per round, token red on you). No server/schema/CLI change. Full suite: the gate on this submission.

GATE: PASS | scope 12 paths | plan-doc ok | tests ok (1399 passed, 5 skipped, 4m15s)
checked: HEAD a919792

The gate's full suite is green (1399 passed, 5 skipped @ a919792), and the focused cockpit activity suite passes (53 passed). One approved empty-state contract is not implemented.

`renderLeadEmpty()` currently hides `#lead-empty` whenever `#lead-timeline` has a child:

```js
$('lead-empty').classList.toggle('hidden', !!list.firstChild);
```

Lead cycle-turn cards (`LLANE`) are children of that same timeline. Therefore, with no conversation yet but one or more lead cycle cards, the “No messages yet …” prompt is hidden. The approved plan explicitly requires the lead lane to show its cycle cards *and*, at the foot above the composer, the no-conversation prompt. This is also the useful first-use state when the watcher has done work before the arbiter starts a chat.

Please base the empty-state visibility on whether the current conversation has messages (not whether the merged timeline has any child), preserving the prompt alongside cycle cards, and add a Node behavioural regression for no conversation + a lead cycle card + prompt visible.

Round 2 — addresses reviewer r1 (branch phase-45-cockpit-lanes @ HEAD "fix(phase-45): the lead lane's 'No messages yet' prompt…", PR #24). gate: see entry.

- cockpit.js `renderLeadEmpty()`: the prompt's visibility is now `hasMessages = LEAD.conv && LEAD.conv.turns.length` — hidden only when the current conversation has messages; the lead's cycle-turn cards (LLANE rows in the same timeline) no longer hide it, so cards + prompt show together in the no-conversation state (plan §C empty state).
- tests/test_cockpit_activity.py `TestLanesBehaviour::test_lead_lane_prompt_stays_with_cards_but_no_messages` (node harness): no conversation → prompt visible; + a lead cycle card → prompt still visible, 1 card; an empty conversation → prompt; the first message → prompt hidden, 2 rows. 54 focused tests pass.
- plan doc: status + "Impl round 2" note.

Full suite: the gate on this submission.
